title: USDA farm payment system cyberattack, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by USDA, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Farm Service Agency offices across the US reported outages in loan, payment and mapping tools for about a week, ahead of a Dec 11 sign-up deadline. The number of farmers affected is not given.
who_is_affected: Farmers and ranchers who use USDA loan, payment and conservation programs, and USDA staff. USDA says no personal information was involved.

known.text: A USDA under secretary called the week-long disruption a cyberthreat, not a software update.
Loan, payment and mapping tools went down, delaying farmer loans and payments.
The disruption began around Monday, Nov 16.
The under secretary says no personal information was involved and no data was lost.

not_known.text: Whether outsiders actually got into the payment system.
Whether every system is back online.
